faq.title: What Swiss clients ask us first.

items.a: Our studio is at ODTÜ Teknokent in Ankara, Turkey. We have no Swiss office. We work fully remotely during Swiss office hours; the time difference is 1 to 2 hours depending on the season.

items.q: Which language do we work in?
items.a: German, French or English. You get one dedicated point of contact for your project.
Within {{stat.response}} hours during office hours. You receive a quote within {{stat.offer}} hours of the intro call.
These are starting prices for a clearly defined scope, all {{vat}} After the intro call you receive a fixed price for your project.

We work in line with the Swiss FADP (revDSG) and the GDPR. For every engagement involving personal data we sign a data processing agreement including standard contractual clauses, because processing takes place in Turkey.

items.q: What do you use AI for?
items.a: Research, drafts, variants and routine tasks. Every output is reviewed by specialists. We do not enter confidential client data into public AI services.
